banner.title: Architects of Digital Excellence
banner.lead: Learn who we are and how we build high-impact web products.

intro.title: A studio built for quality, speed, and modern aesthetics
paragraphs: Zodaweb is a forward-thinking web agency for brands that refuse generic templates. We pair product thinking with meticulous UI, then ship software that stays fast, maintainable, and ready to grow.
From first workshop to launch day, we keep the process transparent: clear milestones, honest estimates, and interfaces that feel as advanced as the technology behind them.
intro.asideText: Small senior teams. Direct communication. Design and engineering in the same room so nothing gets lost between Figma and production.

process.title: How We Build
process.subtitle: A five-step pipeline from discovery through long-term care.

steps.title: Discovery & Planning
steps.text: We map goals, audience, constraints, and success metrics. Scope, timeline, and technical approach are aligned before a single screen is designed.

steps.title: UI/UX Wireframing
steps.text: Flows become wireframes, then high-fidelity Figma systems. Stakeholders review interactive prototypes so decisions happen early, not after code.

steps.title: Clean Code Development
steps.text: We implement with modern stacks—React, Next.js, Node, and more—optimized for performance, accessibility, and future features.

steps.title: Quality Assurance & Testing
steps.text: Functional QA, device coverage, and accessibility checks. We hunt edge cases so launch day is calm, not chaotic.

steps.title: Deployment & Maintenance
steps.text: We ship, monitor, and stay on call. Updates, SEO, and support keep the product compounding after go-live.

items.title: Innovation
items.text: We choose modern patterns that age well—never novelty for its own sake.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Clear timelines, visible progress, and honest trade-offs at every milestone.

items.title: Speed
items.text: Tight loops from decision to deployment without sacrificing craft.

items.title: Client-First Mindset
items.text: Your outcomes define the work: growth, clarity, and a product people trust.
